title: A Novel Human-Computer Interaction Design for Enhancing Accessibility in Early-Stage Alzheimer's Disease

contributions.purpose: 提出随认知负荷自适应的 UI 范式
contributions.mechanism: 根据实时任务完成时间/错误率,用轻量 Bayesian/决策树推断认知状态,动态调整视觉复杂度、信息密度、提示级别
contributions.evaluation: 仅概念/原型,无真实实验;结果为'预期'(hypothesized)
contributions.domain: HCI / 无障碍 / 阿尔茨海默
contributions.source_quote: Introducing a new adaptive UI paradigm that dynamically adjusts interface complexity based on real-time user performance.

contributions.purpose: 以多模态输入适配波动的认知状态
contributions.mechanism: 整合语音(NLP)、手势(前置摄像头 CV)、触控,按上下文与用户偏好智能优先
contributions.evaluation: 无实测数据,仅设计描述
contributions.source_quote: Integrating multimodal input (voice, gesture, touch) to offer flexible interaction methods suitable for varying cognitive states.

contributions.purpose: 提出以用户为中心的设计方法
contributions.mechanism: 四阶段 UCD(共情/构思/原型/评估),纳入患者、照护者、临床专家反馈
contributions.evaluation: 3.2 节声称已访谈 15 患者/20 照护者/5 临床医生并对 8 患者+10 照护者做可用性测试,但与第 5 节'评估为未来工作'矛盾
contributions.source_quote: Presenting a user-centered design methodology that incorporates direct feedback from AD patients, caregivers, and clinicians.

contributions.purpose: 以原型演示提升独立性/降认知负荷的潜力
contributions.mechanism: 平板端 Adaptive Companion Interface(ACI)原型:动态任务卡、简化通讯、记忆相册、认知游戏
contributions.evaluation: 无实证;'预期'任务完成率提升、错误率下降、SUS 高分
contributions.source_quote: Demonstrating the potential for increased independence and reduced cognitive load through a prototype implementation focused on daily task management.

notes: 有自声明四条贡献列表(intro)。非实证适配问题:全文为概念/原型稿,第 5 节评估与'预期结果'全部 hypothesized,无真实数据。数据红旗:3.2 节以完成时态给出具体受试人数(访谈 15 AD+20 照护者+5 临床;可用性测试 8 AD+10 照护者)并称据此迭代改进阈值,但 AI 披露栏自认're-writing Sections 5 and 6 to reflect a conceptual paper without real experimental results',且第 5 节明言评估待未来执行——故 3.2 的受试与研究声称缺乏支撑、疑似虚构。checklist AI 参与度 B/B/B/B;AI 自认局限:对脆弱人群缺乏细腻理解、需人工引导以避免把预期写成定论。低质 desk-reject 类,reject。
